(My Body, My Rights: Education Towards Safe and Informed Choices)

This celebration reminds us of our collective responsibility to protect the rights of every girl, promote informed decision-making, and create safe spaces where girls can grow with confidence, dignity, and empowerment.

The CSWDO encourages all barangays, schools, partner agencies, parents, and the community to support activities that promote awareness, education, and protection for every girl in our city.

Together, let us continue to build a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where every girl in Cabanatuan City can thrive, dream, and achieve her full potential. 💫
